title: Turn Current Research and Top Minds prose into preserved, typed, contestable evidence packets
desired_change: Create ResearchSource, ResearchClaim, ResearchAdoptionDecision, FreshnessCheck, and MindCard schemas plus instances with exact publication/access dates, primary artifact snapshots, claim-level citations, contradiction searches, incentive context, selection rationale, falsifiers, affected objects, and Proposed Move links.
expected_outcome: An outsider can reproduce why an external idea or person was included, what Quirk adopted, and what would reverse the decision.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Unreproducible expert selection and stale claims can launder taste or vendor incentives into canon.

hidden_context_dependencies: Current Research names standards and version/date claims but does not include typed source records or preserved snapshots.
Top Minds selects eleven people without a documented source census or selection rubric.
Many claims cite landing pages rather than exact artifact locations.
No adoption receipts, contradiction records, or freshness jobs exist.
The chosen council may reflect Bryan's prior reading rather than an independently reproducible selection.
acceptance_checks: Every adopted claim resolves to exact primary evidence and access date.
Each Mind Card includes selection rationale, disagreements, falsifiers, and institutional context.
A freshness check can supersede stale claims.
No expert name acts as authority by itself.
Research adoption creates Proposed Moves rather than canon.
